description: This file defines the GuardTokenParser class within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'guard' tags in Twig templates. It handles syntax parsing, guard type validation, and control flow during template parsing.

classes.name: GuardTokenParser
classes.description: A class extending AbstractTokenParser that parses the 'guard' tag in Twig templates, capable of handling guard types like function, filter, and test, and supporting optional 'else' blocks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'guard' tag in a Twig template, validating guard type, checking existence via environment methods, and handling optional 'else' blocks.

methods.name: decideGuardFork
methods.description: Helper method to determine if current token indicates the start of an 'else' or 'endguard' block.

methods.name: decideGuardEnd
methods.description: Helper method to determine if current token marks the end of a 'guard' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'guard', the tag name this parser handles.
